area: Menu UI: the Ark's Pilots tab, the Hangar's Pilots list, the pilot profile page, the account inventory
summary: All 50 painted pilots join every crew (callsigns may repeat; each painted pilot once, PilotRecord.PaintedKey, AccountInventory.PaintedGranted). The Ark's Pilots tab pages 18 cells at a time with < > and a page label; the Hangar has a card per painted pilot showing the person's close-up; the profile page's words panel is alpha 0.9 with every row in TextLight (Garrett: a tiny bit of transparency). Note for ark-rework: author_menu_ark.py's pilots_page gained the pager.
